title: Conditional κ = .00362106 (+0.470% over #6931): allow 1/3 and 1/5 as gate scalars
body:
## Result

Conditional κ = **0.00362105861** (exact crossing 0.0036210586137481461), **+0.470% over #6931** (0.0036041048151080064). Package: `research/p104-odd-scalar-native`. **This is a declared framework change:** the word uses gate scalars 1/3 and 1/5, outside the dyadic scalar alphabet of the native verifiers. Maintainers must accept the clause; acceptance is not claimed and the result depends on it.

## What changed against #6931

Roots, joint caller (byte-identical), per-port root pair, owned-ascent declaration (A6) and the BIT line (#6726) are those of #6931, and the other conditional premises are the same. The word and the scalar alphabet change.

- **Move, in plain terms.** Coefficients may now have denominators 3 and 5 (products 9, 15, 25, 45, 75, 225). 3 = 2²−1 and 5 = 2²+1, so multiplying is a shift and one add or subtract; exact division is one least-significant-bit-first pass with a checked remainder. Every root input is multiplied once by S = 225 = 3²5² (the least certificate), after which every prefix row and every product is dyadic and every checked division is exact. The word has 3,001 odd divisions (59 SCALE, 2,942 ADD) = 6,002 scans per call, priced separately.
- **What it buys.** Ten more helper splits (kernel term −55.24 per call; T +2, +7, +1, +2, +7, −9 at ranks 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9) and 39 stops merged into rank-2 jobs (78 paid jobs of rank 1 become 39 of rank 2; −54.07 per call). Twenty of the 39 come from a legal reordering of commuting events, tested by `reorder_check.py` (no pair of events sharing a register with a writer changes order). The rank mass S = 1520 is unchanged; the gain is in D alone.
- **Changed clauses:** the dyadic scalar alphabet (`local.py:146,149`, the verifier copies, `native.py:65`); `03-motifs.tex:57,556` for the internal arrays of one parent word; the #6030-specific constants of #6900 and #6901; one added operation (multiply, check divisibility, divide) at `05-layers.tex:510-513`. **Replacement:** A = Z[1/2,1/3,1/5] with |q|+1 < 2^16 kept, a declared S certifying every prefix row, every pre-ADD product and every public row; completed endpoints stay Gaussian dyadic. **Penalty:** none in S; width only, 15 denominator bits and 37.48 magnitude bits per unfinished context, absorbed in W = p+h+2D+3 by 82t < d, which assumes K_star and the caller mass are recomputed for this word (they are not). Method: the merged odd grid of #104 (icekylinx, `notes/stopped-product-complex.tex:75-106`) with its merged reviews. See `PROOF.md`.
- **Exactness is conditional on exact child returns**, a premise shared with the dyadic words. A truncated child makes this word fail its own divisibility check (event 26,563 at g = 44, event 24,158 at g = 50), where the dyadic baseline runs through and is wrong on 830 of 1,441 rows. Fallback: rounded division (measured exit-error gain 2^14.65 at g = 44 on the earlier stage word, one input, not re-measured here).
- Numbers: public registers 1451 (400 mains, 1051 helpers); events 67,079; peak owned fields 36; raw literal / actual / reviewed upper 962,308,192 / 972,123,664 / 985,187,200, below 10^9; the conservative recharge counts LAMBDA a second time: 997,747,200 with the scale at the root, 999,836,640 with every public register scaled on every call; logarithm power minimum 2222, written 2223 (carrier 153), BIT pin margin 1.456e-4; largest |q| 40,864.

## Checks (all run from the package, all pass)

Exact replay with the S certificate and endpoints, the odd verifier and 26 acceptance and rejection controls (S = 75, 45, 15, 25, 9, 1; 1/7; |q| over the bound; non-dyadic public row; dyadic S = 1 word), both roots, the joint caller (78 roles, 18 contacts), the invoice recounted twice, interval engines and the 54 + 4 outer ledger, a second replay mod 2^61−1 with mutants, 512-component streams, an integer run of one column with generic frames, 3,230 native chart maps, the caller physical replay, and the exhaustive division-pass test. Validator: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-odd-scalar-native`.

## Disclosures and not claimed

- 5 of 57,023 ADD ×2 mutants are not caught: they leave the exact endpoint unchanged (four dead stores into owned register 1459, present in the earlier stage word, and one coefficient-neutral temporary).
- 120 rewritten events and 76 tuned events are validated by exact replay only.
- Adjustments to retained checkers: `native.py` and `verify_relaxed.py`/`verify_strict.py` (odd-alphabet relaxation, exact lines in the README); the clause "first 8 SCALEs are the gauge" is informational. The mod-p streams do not test divisibility; the integer run is one column, not true Clifford frames, not tensor width 2.
- Not claimed: maintainer acceptance of the odd-scalar clause, A6, the per-port root, LAMBDA as ordinary work or the BIT admission; K_star and the caller mass for this word; a rounded child return; no second-reader review.

Credit: icekylinx (#104, odd grid), Ali Romman (#5599, helper-split lemma), CubeJerry (#6916, application to the shared native word; #6805, #6824, #6890, #6900, #6901), and the retained work of #6919, #6917, #6911, #6902, #6889, #6833, #6726.
